slogan: Your head needs a service too
title: Cápsula — your head needs a service too
metaDesc: Memory, focus, sleep, fear of stroke. Four taps, nothing to type — and you get a clear profile and a plan for the week. Free, no sign-up, nothing is stored.
heroSub: Four taps, nothing to type. A clear profile, a plan for the week, reminders in your calendar.
introNote: Nothing is stored: your answers stay on your phone.

about.vessels: Vessels: when you last checked your blood pressure and bloods — and what is worth checking.
about.sleep: Sleep: snoring, waking up exhausted, under 6 hours — and whom to ask.
about.head: Head: memory, focus, interest in things — and what to do this week.
about.plan: Weekly plan: at most three actions, with reminders in your calendar.

disclaimer: This is not medical advice — discuss it with your doctor.
honest: No diagnoses, no risk percentages, no promises. Only what is worth checking, whom to see and when to be reminded.
shareText: Your head needs a service too. Four taps, nothing to type — a profile and a plan for the week:

o.now: 🚨 Symptoms right now: numbness, drooping face, slurred speech

check.text: When did you last check your blood pressure and bloods?
check.hint: Blood pressure, cholesterol, sugar — at the doctor or a pharmacy.

resultSub: Three lines — and what they mean right now.

head.ok: Memory and focus aren't the main issue for now.
head.warn: Memory and focus usually come down to sleep and load — start there.
head.bad: Your head is asking for attention: time to talk to a doctor, not to push through.

sleep.warn: You're short on sleep — a week of routine will show where the problem is.
sleep.bad: Snoring and waking up exhausted is a reason to ask about a sleep study.

vessels.ok: Blood pressure and bloods checked recently — good.
vessels.warn: It's been a while since you checked blood pressure and bloods — it's easy to do.
vessels.bad: Vessels first: blood pressure, cholesterol, sugar.

planHint: Three actions at most. The rest can wait.

bp3.t: Measure blood pressure three mornings in a row
bp3.s: Seated, before coffee, write down the numbers.

gp.t: Book your médico de família / blood tests
gp.s: Blood pressure, cholesterol, sugar — one visit.

sleepq.t: Ask your doctor about a sleep study
sleepq.s: Snoring and exhaustion can be checked.

sleep7.t: One week: 7 hours and the same wake-up time
sleep7.s: No screens in the hour before bed.

walk.s: Your head needs oxygen more than coffee.

recheck.s: Six months have passed — four taps again.

emergencyText: Numb arm or face, slurred speech, sudden weakness — this is not for a web page. Call now.
